5 pin functions TPD4E05U06 DQA: 1 D1+, 2 D1−, 4 D2+, 5 D2− ESD protected channels; 3, 8 GND; 6, 7, 9, 10 NC ('Used for optional straight-through routing. Can be left floating or grounded')
6.4: VIO 0 … 5.5 V, TA −40 … 125 °C; 6.6: VRWM 5.5 V (IIO < 10 µA), VBR 6.5–8.5 V at 1 mA, leakage 10 nA max at 2.5 V, line capacitance 0.5 pF typ
no rail pin: each channel has its own diodes to ground – the model has only the diode from ground (esd_array without vbus)
